theorem ramare_bound {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    |GqP d R - (Nat.totient d / d) * (Real.log R + cR + SqP d)| ≤
      7.284 * R ^ (-(1 / 3 : ℝ)) * TernaryGoldbach.Prelim.f1qP d :=

provenance.method: re-judged at the pin; key relations re-judged blind, statement against statement (2026-11-12)

note: Lean proves Ramaré's Lemma 3.4 for all d (with 7.04 internally), which contains both lines; it is not one of the hypotheses. Erratum: The product prod_p(1 + (p^{1/3} + p^{2/3})/(p(p-1))) that [Ram95] (3.9) bounds by 8 already passes 8 at p = 14629 and is 8.0723 for p <= 2*10^6, so 0.9105 times it exceeds 7.35, not 7.284; the script checks only this numerical content, not the text of Ramare's proof (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_c_10.py`).
